major_mineral_belts: North-Eastern Peninsular Belt (Jharkhand-Odisha), Central Belt (Durg-Bastar-Chandrapur), South-Western Belt (Bellary-Chitradurga)
geological_formation: Dharwar and Archaean Supergroup (Banded Iron Formations - BIF)
top_producing_states_and_reserves: Odisha (leads in extraction, >50%), Chhattisgarh, Karnataka, Jharkhand
major_mines_and_districts: Bailadila (Dantewada, CG), Badampahar & Gorumahisani (Mayurbhanj, OD), Noamundi (West Singhbhum, JH), Kudremukh & Donimalai (Bellary, KA)
associated_ores_and_grades: High-grade Hematite (60-65% Fe content) and Magnetite (black magnetic ore, Kudremukh)
industrial_applications: Primary feedstock for domestic integrated blast-furnace steel mills, sponge iron units, civil construction
import_dependency_and_strategic_status: Completely self-sufficient; major net exporter of iron ore lumps and fines to China and Japan
regulatory_framework: Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act (MMDR Act), Indian Bureau of Mines (IBM)

major_mineral_belts: Eastern Ghats Mobile Belt, Chota Nagpur Plateau, Maikala Range, Amarkantak Plateau
geological_formation: Tertiary lateritic cappings over basaltic plateaus and Deccan Traps
top_producing_states_and_reserves: Odisha (>50% of national output), Gujarat, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra
major_mines_and_districts: Panchpatmali & Damanjodi (Koraput, OD), Baphlimali (Rayagada, OD), Lohardaga (JH), Amarkantak (Bilaspur, CG)
associated_ores_and_grades: Gibbsite, Boehmite, and Diaspore associated with iron oxides and silica
industrial_applications: Extraction of alumina via Bayer process for aluminum metal smelting, aerospace alloys, refractories, cement
import_dependency_and_strategic_status: Abundant domestic reserves, fully self-reliant with exports of alumina chemicals and bauxite ore
regulatory_framework: MMDR Amendment Acts, National Aluminium Company Limited (NALCO), Geological Survey of India (GSI)

major_mineral_belts: Sub-Himalayan folded belts, South Karnataka pegmatite belts
geological_formation: Salal-Haimana bauxitic-clay limestone zones (Jammu) and granitic pegmatites (Mandya)
top_producing_states_and_reserves: Jammu & Kashmir (inferred G4 reserves of 5.9 MT in Reasi), Karnataka (Mandya district reserves), Rajasthan (Degana)
associated_ores_and_grades: Spodumene, Lepidolite, and clay-hosted bauxite-lithiferous deposits
industrial_applications: Lithium-ion batteries for Electric Vehicles (EVs), grid energy storage, smartphone batteries, atomic lubricants
import_dependency_and_strategic_status: Near 100% import reliant (mainly from China, Chile, and Australia); categorized as a Tier-1 Critical Mineral
regulatory_framework: Offshore and Onshore Critical Mineral Auction Traunches, Khanij Bidesh India Ltd (KABIL)

major_mineral_belts: Damodar Valley, Mahanadi Valley, Son Valley, Wardha-Godavari Valley
geological_formation: Gondwana Coalfields (over 98% of reserves, Permian strata) and Tertiary Coal (Assam, Meghalaya)
top_producing_states_and_reserves: Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand (highest reserves), Madhya Pradesh, Telangana (Singareni)
major_mines_and_districts: Jharia (sole prime coking coal mine, Dhanbad, JH), Raniganj (first coalfield, WB), Korba (CG), Talcher (OD)
associated_ores_and_grades: Bituminous (high ash, non-coking), Anthracite (minimal in J&K), Lignite (Neyveli, Tamil Nadu)
industrial_applications: Thermal power generation (>70% of India's electricity), blast furnace reductant in steel making, cement kilns
import_dependency_and_strategic_status: Self-sufficient in thermal non-coking coal; imports over 85% of prime metallurgical coking coal for steel
regulatory_framework: Coal Mines (Special Provisions) Act, Commercial Coal Mine E-Auctions, Coal India Limited (CIL)

major_mineral_belts: Coastal Placer Sand Belts of Southern and Eastern India, inland teris of Tamil Nadu
geological_formation: Quaternary coastal beach sands formed from weathering of Charnockites and Khondalites
top_producing_states_and_reserves: Odisha, Kerala (Chavara), Tamil Nadu (Manavalakurichi), Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat
major_mines_and_districts: Chavara beach sands (Kollam, KL), Manavalakurichi (Kanyakumari, TN), OSCOM (Chatrapur, Ganjam, OD)
associated_ores_and_grades: Monazite (contains Thorium and Light REEs like Lanthanum, Cerium, Neodymium), Ilmenite, Rutile, Zircon
industrial_applications: Permanent magnets for wind turbines, electric vehicle motors, military guidance systems, nuclear fuel (Thorium)
import_dependency_and_strategic_status: India has the 3rd largest reserves of Monazite worldwide, but downstream refining into permanent magnets relies on imports
regulatory_framework: Atomic Energy Act 1962, IREL (India) Limited (formerly Indian Rare Earths Limited), DAE
